text:
lina: quick q — we noticed some SDK parsing tests failing for the /v1/usage response. did we land the cached token fields in the contract? pinging before i open a PR.
chad: yep we merged cached_* fields last week. main change: responses now include cached_prompt_tokens and cached_completion_tokens + cache_hit boolean per-request. billing still uses billable_tokens which is prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_* (if cache_billing_optin=true).
devex: can you paste the exact response shape you're seeing? i want to ensure the SDK handles missing fields (backcompat).
lina: here's an example from prod that broke the parser:
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "completion_tokens": 80,
  "cached_prompt_tokens": 20,
  "cached_completion_tokens": 0,
  "cache_hit": false,
  "billable_tokens": 180
}
```
chad: hmm billable_tokens 180 matches prompt+completion (200) minus cached total (20) = 180. SDK should prefer billable_tokens when present and fall back to computed value otherwise. we added billable_tokens for explicit accounting.
devex: SDK change should be tiny: prefer response.billable_tokens if typeof === 'number'; else compute with cached_* if present. also tolerate missing cached_* (treat as 0). i'll open a small PR to add that fallback.
accounting-bot: FYI accounting pipeline only consumes billable_tokens and origin_tag (origin: "hosted" | "dedicated" | "private") — cached_* not used downstream. if teams start sending cache_billing_optin=false we will still default to computed tokens.
lina: ok, two compatibility questions: 1) should the API ever omit prompt_tokens/completion_tokens and only include billable_tokens? 2) what about older SDKs that assume `tokens` flat field?
chad: 1) not planned; prompt_tokens + completion_tokens will remain for at least 6 months. 2) we scheduled a deprecation: `tokens` (legacy) will be accepted but not emitted; servers will emit a `warnings` header when `tokens` is used by clients. we'll document in the breaking-changes doc.
jordan: i can review the SDK PR and the API docs update. can we add a sample for canary rollout? recommend feature-flag on the response that signals "cache_fields_v1": true for canary traffic. :eyes:
lina: perfect. i'll add test cases for missing cached_* and for billable_tokens present. also adding one test for "cache_fields_v1": false to ensure old clients still parse.
devex: plan for rollout: deploy API change behind flag, ship SDK fallback, enable canary for 5% for 48h, then 50% for 24h, then full if no regressions. add an alert if billable_tokens delta > 5% vs computed over 10k samples.
chad: added to eng-runbook and canary config. tagging @jordan for code review once devex PR is up. :thumbsup:
lina: thanks all — i'll follow up with PR links and a short doc in the api-contracts folder.
